database.db_version: PostgreSQL 16.14 (Debian 16.14-1.pgdg12+1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX capability_similar_queries_embedding_hnsw ON public.capability_similar_queries USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_similar_queries_pkey ON public.capability_similar_queries USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX capability_similar_queries_standard_idx ON public.capability_similar_queries USING btree (standard_query_id)
CREATE INDEX capability_standard_queries_embedding_hnsw ON public.capability_standard_queries USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_standard_queries_one_per_language ON public.capability_standard_queries USING btree (capability_id, language)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX capability_standard_queries_pkey ON public.capability_standard_queries USING btree (id)

recall.capabilities_included: all 18, including cap-research and hidden caps

aggregation.reject: one uppercase REJECT card appended after capability cards

language_rule.blank: Han only -> zh; Latin only -> en; Han+Latin -> mixed; neither -> unknown

query_family_rule.signature: first 5 whitespace tokens if >=3 tokens, else first 12 chars

split.integer_rule: minimum representation for n<3; largest-remainder style remainder with max(1, round()) for n>=3
split.family_grouping: whole family assigned to one split

schema.v2_loader_modified: option-count/permutation/gold-index validation generalized from fixed 4 to the row's actual K+1 (1..4); schema, labels, REJECT construction and target semantics unchanged
schema.card_source: production cap_router.card_renderer.render_card over the live Registry; byte-identical to V2/data/aligned, not V2/data base
